inShort: B learns to take the pace off without a swing: first catch and send A's soft balls, then block A's hard third ball after two dinks.
rules: A and B stand straight across at the kitchen line.
Round 1, catch and send: A taps the ball up and sends it to B. B catches it softly on the paddle and sends it back, with no swing at all.
Round 2: A dinks twice, then hits the third ball hard at B. B blocks it into the kitchen, then you dink on.
Keep the paddle out in front, never behind the body. No loop before the block.
The harder A hits, the less B pushes; on softer balls B pushes a little more.
tooEasy: B stands in the middle of the transition zone, blocks A's hard balls into the kitchen and moves up to the line after every good block.
tooHard: Stay in round 1 until B catches every ball softly.
goodLooksLike: B's block drops softly into the kitchen, and B's paddle barely moves.

drill.title: Soft Hands Progression – Block Volley from the Kitchen to Midcourt
